description: Returns a system prompt + structured context block, scoped to one ticker. Drop it into OpenAI/Anthropic/any LLM SDK to ground your chatbot in current Deep Values data without months of plumbing. Bills 3 metadata units. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/ai-context/{ticker}, e.g. https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/ai-context/AAPL — 0.02 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 1 call(s)/day per address) Missing data? Call `request_data`.

ticker.description: The real ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL; share classes as BRK.B or BRK-B. Substitute it into the path (/fundamentals/AAPL), never the literal {ticker}.
